MSc Business Analytics student at Baruch College, passionate about transforming data into strategic and insightful decisions.

::: {#about .section .section--light}
## About

An MSc Business Analytics graduate student at Baruch College with a background in marketing, data analytics, and operations. Over the past few years, I have worked across education, tech, and construction sectors, using data to improve campaign performance, streamline operations, and support strategic decision-making.

From managing student databases and analyzing web traffic to building dashboards and running A/B tests, I enjoy solving problems and finding insights that add real value. My toolkit includes **Python**, **SQL**, **Excel**, **Tableau**, **Power BI**, and **Google Analytics**.

What drives me is the opportunity to work on projects that create impact, whether it is improving marketing ROI, helping students reach their goals, or building smarter systems through data.
:::
